test(lib): run the analyzer regime on the test project, warning-free

ReScene.Tests now builds with EnableNETAnalyzers + AnalysisLevel=latest-All +
EnforceCodeStyleInBuild (+ GenerateDocumentationFile so IDE0005 runs), matching
the library and ending the inversion where only production code was analyzed.

underscore test names, CA5394 seeded Random, CA1003 Action-based recorder
hooks, IDE0330 net8.0 has no System.Threading.Lock). Everything else was
fixed for real: IDE0055/0004/0230/0042/0059/0290/0370 via per-rule dotnet
format passes, plus hand fixes for CA1861 constant-array args, CA1823 unused
field, CA1304/CA1311 ToLowerInvariant, CS1573/CS1574 doc crefs, IDE0060
unused parameter — and one CA1307 (ordinal IndexOf) the sweep surfaced in
SRRFile.ExtractStoredFiles itself.

Both TFM legs verified: 1558 tests green, zero build warnings.

message:
perf(http-server): avoid to_lowercase alloc in Host header normalization

Use ascii case check and trailing-dot check to skip allocation on the
fast path (lowercase host without dot, common for benchmarks). Only
allocate when upper-case or trailing dot is present, and use
to_ascii_lowercase (cheaper than Unicode to_lowercase). Saves
String alloc + HashMap hashing per request.

fix(gates): pin LC_ALL=C in required-checks-verify.sh and prove §9 in both locales (#17905)

The same clean origin/main tree read GREEN under LC_ALL=C and RED under
en_US.UTF-8: the tracked corpus carries a byte that is not valid UTF-8, so
advisory_prose_check's awk aborted with "towc: multibyte conversion failure"
and §9's sed then died on that error text with "RE error: illegal byte
sequence". The verdict was about the operator's shell, not about the repo.

required-checks-verify.sh now exports LC_ALL=C once, right after `set -euo
pipefail`, for every text tool it forks — the pin the merge-truth awk has
carried alone since cch-w34, hoisted to the whole script. Nothing here needs
the caller's locale: no `date`, no `printf "%'d"`, and every sort feeds a set
comparison rather than a human eye.

required-checks.test.sh §9 now runs the selftest twice, under an explicit
LC_ALL=C and under a UTF-8 locale it first PROVES exists via `locale charmap`
(an unknown LC_ALL falls back to C and the arm would be vacuous). Both arms
keep the clause-count print, read off the selftest's own numbering.

py-snowballstemmer: update to 3.0.1.

Snowball 3.0.1 (2025-05-09)
===========================

Python
------

* The __init__.py in 3.0.0 was incorrectly generated due to a missing
  build dependency and the list of algorithms was empty.  First reported by
  laymonage.  Thanks to Dmitry Shachnev, Henry Schreiner and Adam Turner for
  diagnosing and fixing.  (#229, #230, #231)

* Add trove classifiers for Armenian and Yiddish which have now been registered
  with PyPI.  Thanks to Henry Schreiner and Dmitry Shachnev.  (#228)

* Update documented details of Python 2 support in old versions.

Snowball 3.0.0 (2025-05-08)
===========================

Ada
---

* Bug fixes:

  + Fix invalid Ada code generated for Snowball `loop` (it was partly Pascal!)
    None of the stemmers shipped in previous releases triggered this bug, but
    the Turkish stemmer now does.

  + The Ada runtime was not tracking the current length of the string
    but instead used the current limit value or some other substitute, which
    manifested as various incorrect behaviours for code inside of `setlimit`.

  + `size` was incorrectly returning the difference between the limit and the
    backwards limit.

  + `lenof` or `sizeof` on a string variable generated Ada code that didn't
    even compile.

  + Fix incorrect preconditions on some methods in the runtime.

  + Fix bug in runtime code used by `attach`, `insert`, `<-` and string
    variable assignment when a (sub)string was replaced with a larger strin

message:
Make config system locale-independent

Replace locale-sensitive string operations with explicit locale specifications
to ensure consistent behavior across different system locales:
- Use Text.format() or String.format(Locale.ROOT, ...) for formatting
- Use toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) and toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT) for case conversion
- Add explicit DecimalFormatSymbols(Locale.ENGLISH) for number formatting
- Specify UTF-8 charset explicitly for file I/O operations

This prevents subtle bugs where string operations might produce different
results depending on the system's default locale.

message:
Fix 5 code-review findings in the Phase 4 search/hashtag pipeline

- Hashtag get-or-create's unique-constraint retry ran on the same Postgres
  transaction the failed insert had just aborted; the insert now runs in
  HashtagCreator's own REQUIRES_NEW transaction so the retry lookup happens
  on a still-valid one.
- Reels were indexed for search at creation time, before their video finished
  transcoding; indexing now happens in MediaUploadConsumer once transcoding
  succeeds, matching the READY_FILTER invariant every listing query enforces.
- Locking an account to private only re-indexed the user document, leaving
  their already-indexed posts searchable forever; updateProfile now retracts
  them too.
- Meilisearch startup setup had no error handling, unlike the equivalent
  StorageConfig precedent, so an unready Meilisearch container could crash
  app startup; wrapped in the same try/catch-and-warn pattern.
- Hashtag browsing lowercased the path variable with the JVM default locale
  while storage used Locale.ROOT, a latent lookup-miss bug on some locales.

feat: improve mention normalization for unstructured entity clustering

- Rewrite _normalize() with multi-step pipeline: NFKD decomposition,
  diacritic removal, apostrophe/hyphen variant normalization, whitespace
  collapse, and casefold
- Add pre-compiled regex patterns _RE_APOSTROPHE_VARIANTS,
  _RE_HYPHEN_VARIANTS, _RE_WHITESPACE
- Bump _CLUSTER_VERSION v1.1 → v1.2 to signal changed cluster logic
- Expand module docstring with a Mention normalisation section
- Add 27 new tests covering diacritics, NFKD, apostrophe/hyphen variants,
  whitespace collapse, casefold, and normalization-aware clustering
